rule: A check more than 2 trading sessions behind the freshest check is shown with its figure but does not count toward the reading. If fewer than 4 of the 6 checks count, no single reading is published.
Stressed: a counting fear check at 25 or more, whatever the rest say.
Trending up: both trend checks above half, and the S&P 500 fund above its flip level, with all three checks counting.
Trending down: both trend checks below half, and the S&P 500 fund below its flip level, with all three checks counting.
Range-bound: a counting fear check under 20, neither trending reading met, and the day's moves not strongly one-sided (more than two thirds of stocks moving the same way would be strongly one-sided).
Anything else reads as mixed: no clear reading.
